_provenance.note: Vanilla block tags are bound before measuring default item stacks. Every state is checked before collapsing facts by block name. Custom stack components and server data packs can override default tool behavior.

default_components.note: Native Tool.CODEC with RegistryOps<JsonOps>. Every registered item is measured; null means no Tool component. Rule order, tag names, direct block selectors and optional fields are retained.
